questions.factFinding: Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System.
questions.bilingualFinding: Largest refers to planetary size, consistent in both languages.

questions.factFinding: Earth is the third planet from the Sun.
questions.bilingualFinding: Outward ordinal and Mercury/Venus explanation match.

questions.factFinding: Nitrogen is the largest component of Earth’s near-surface atmosphere.
questions.bilingualFinding: Near-surface qualifier retained; nitrogen about 78 percent.

questions.factFinding: Oxidized iron in Martian material contributes to its reddish appearance.
questions.bilingualFinding: Red appearance linked to oxidized iron, not every surface color.

questions.factFinding: Titan is Saturn’s largest moon.
questions.bilingualFinding: Titan belongs to Saturn; Chinese 土卫六 is an intentional easy clue.

questions.factFinding: The Sun is the Solar System’s only star.
questions.bilingualFinding: Scope is our Solar System, not the universe.

questions.factFinding: The Pacific is the largest ocean basin.
questions.bilingualFinding: Largest refers to basin area; no changing depth number.

questions.factFinding: Challenger Deep is in the Mariana Trench.
questions.bilingualFinding: Location only; no disputed maximum-depth numeric claim.

questions.factFinding: The SI base unit of electric current is the ampere.
questions.bilingualFinding: Electric current, ampere and A agree.

questions.factFinding: The SI base unit of amount of substance is the mole.
questions.bilingualFinding: Amount of substance, mole and mol agree.

questions.factFinding: The SI base unit of thermodynamic temperature is the kelvin.
questions.bilingualFinding: Thermodynamic temperature rather than Celsius scale.

questions.factFinding: The SI base unit of length is the metre.
questions.bilingualFinding: SI base length unit, metre/meter translation 米.

questions.factFinding: The Taj Mahal is in India.
questions.bilingualFinding: Country and Agra explanation agree.

questions.factFinding: Machu Picchu is in Peru.
questions.bilingualFinding: Peru and Andes location agree.

questions.factFinding: Petra is in Jordan.
questions.bilingualFinding: Jordan country assignment agrees.

questions.factFinding: Angkor is in Cambodia.
questions.bilingualFinding: Cambodia and Siem Reap region agree.

questions.factFinding: The pyramid fields at Giza are in Egypt.
questions.bilingualFinding: Giza pyramid fields in Egypt agree.

questions.factFinding: The Galápagos Islands belong to Ecuador.
questions.bilingualFinding: UNESCO country field Ecuador; both versions ask national location.

questions.factFinding: Stonehenge is in the United Kingdom.
questions.bilingualFinding: Country United Kingdom; explanation distinguishes England.

questions.factFinding: The Acropolis of Athens is in Greece.
questions.bilingualFinding: Athens, Greece country assignment agrees.
